notes:
Summary: Lindholm is a long-standing OT integrator moving into AI-enabled incident response and operator assist. Big constraints: absolutely no outbound inference calls, HSM-backed key management, signed binaries only, STIG/FIPS expectations. CISO quote: 'If the model can't live in our enclave and we can't fully audit queries and retention, we can't proceed.'

Key technical asks / paraphrases from calls:
- On-prem private control plane, ability to disable all external egress; support for air-gapped installer and offline license activation.
- KMS/HSM integration (Thales / AWS CloudHSM equivalence) and FIPS-validated crypto.
- Audit logs with token-level traces, ability to export to their SIEM (Splunk).
- Model pinning + rollout controls; reproducible model hashes and signed model artifacts.
- Deterministic rerank / explainability for critical responses; automated regression alerts tied to their prompt set.
- Data residency and retention controls; retention window enforcement + redaction pipeline for PII.

Sales notes: procurement timeline is long, procurement is comfortable with enterprise CI vendors. They frequently evaluate 'internal_build' and a smaller private vendor. Primary champion is Head of AI Ops (Marcus Reid); CISO (Elena Vargo) is strict on export controls. Presales action: prepare air-gapped installer checklist and offline license flow doc.

Quote from Marcus (paraphrase): 'We need to be 100% sure the model weights and inferences never leave our racks; show me a clean install flow and we can proceed to hardware allocation.'
